source.title: Verify Preorder Serialization of a Binary Tree

teaching.hint: What must still be supplied after reading any prefix of the token sequence?

solution_outline.decisive_insight: Each token fills one outstanding tree position, while a non-null node creates two new child positions.
solution_outline.approach: Scan the tokens with one initial root position. Consume one position for every token and add two for a value; reject when a token has no position, and accept only if none remain at the end.
solution_outline.state_and_invariant: The position count equals the number of unfilled child obligations implied by the processed preorder prefix.
solution_outline.correctness: The token grammar is `tree = #` or `value tree tree`; the count exactly tracks its pending subtrees. Negative count means extra tokens, and positive final count means missing tokens.
solution_outline.complexity: `O(L)` time for string length `L` and `O(1)` auxiliary state beyond token parsing.
solution_outline.pitfall: Checking only the final count misses a prefix that completed a tree before more tokens arrived.

common_wrong_turns: Check only the final token count
source_fidelity_notes: Retains the no-reconstruction rule and clarifies that a single `#` is valid.
